walk_meta.subtitle: Kap Karoso Farm Walk & Culture Workshop · Southwest Sumba
walk_meta.excerpt: A morning on the Kap Karoso farm — compost, chicken houses, Sandalwood ponies and a programme for local growers — then an hour on Sumbanese culture: Marapu, the Pasola, bride prices paid in livestock and the legend of the sea worms.
